Method of Attack: Deploys 9hits viewer app on compromised Docker hosts to generate credits by visiting websites using a headless Chrome instance
Deploys XMRig miner container mining Monero cryptocurrency using all available CPU resources
Uses Docker API to deploy malicious containers from Dockerhub images
Uses session token authentication to generate credits securely without risk of ban
Miner connects to private mining pool using dynamic DNS services to maintain control
Attack Vector: Network scanning (likely via Shodan) to find vulnerable Docker servers
Docker API exploitation to deploy malicious containers
Indicators of Compromise: Use of Dockerhub images for malicious containers
Presence of nh.sh script with session token in 9hits container
Connection to private Monero mining pool domain with dynamic DNS
High CPU usage from XMRig miner
High bandwidth and memory usage from 9hits viewer app
